facts.business: Andrew Yule & Company Limited is a Government of India enterprise engaged in tea cultivation, engineering, and electrical manufacturing operations.

auditor.name: N.C Banerjee & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) Incomplete audit trail implementation with significant manual intervention in consolidation; 2) Proposal for closure of two wholly owned subsidiaries submitted to Ministry of Heavy Industries; 3) Absence of balance confirmations for debtors/creditors with receivables of Rs 11,653.79 lakh and provisions of Rs 2,902.05 lakh; 4) Absence of IT system audit and high audit risk from manual data transfer; 5) Inadequate controls over lease/title deeds; 6) Delays in deposit of PF, gratuity, leave encashment totaling Rs 7,243.99 lakh and unprovided PF damages of Rs 455.86 lakh; 7) SEBI penalty for non-compliance with audit committee formation.

key_risks: Severe climatic disruptions impacting tea division profitability
Inflationary cost pressures and market price volatility
Incomplete audit trail and manual intervention in consolidation
Absence of balance confirmations for significant receivables
Lack of IT system audit and disaster recovery
Statutory payment delays (PF, gratuity, leave encashment)
Proposed closure of wholly owned subsidiaries
